How we work

Three rules.

One job per agent

Each agent does one task well. Small, clear, measurable.

People decide

Important steps are approved. Every action is logged.

Prove it, then grow

Start with one agent. Add the next when it works.

Our footprint

Built with 🧡 in India. Running worldwide.

Somewhere right now, one of our agents is awake: following up a lead in the US, checking consent in the UK, mapping data in the EU. The people who made it are in Kolkata, Bangalore and Durgapur.
